company: Goodman Group (Goodman Limited, Goodman Funds Management Limited as responsible entity for Goodman Industrial Trust, and Goodman Logistics (HK) Limited)
title: Securities Trading Policy
date_approved: June 2021 (approved by the Boards of Goodman Limited, Goodman Funds Management Limited and Goodman Logistics (HK) Limited)
date_next_review: every two years or earlier in response to significant regulatory developments

tiers.name: team members
tiers.description: All Directors of Goodman and its related bodies corporate, all employees (permanent, temporary, contractors, secondees) and their associates. All rules apply to this tier: insider trading ban, blackout periods, consent before any trading (Group CEO or Company Secretary), margin call rules, derivative hedging conditions, unvested hedging ban, short selling ban and the short-term trading discouragement.

tiers.name: Directors
tiers.description: Directors of Goodman and its related bodies corporate. Distinguished only for consent routing: Directors seek the Chairman's consent and the Chairman seeks the Audit Committee Chair's consent. Directors are also key management personnel for the margin loan ban.

tiers.name: Executives (Group CEO-1)
tiers.description: Direct reports to the Group CEO. Distinguished only for blackout-period exceptional circumstances consent, which must come from a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary.

tiers.name: Key management personnel
tiers.description: KMP as defined in the Corporations Act and included in the most recent Remuneration Report. Must not have a margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities.

tiers.name: associates
tiers.description: Close family members and people or entities (such as family companies or self managed pension funds) where the Director or employee has any influence over the investment process or where they act on behalf of the Director or employee. Included within 'team members' and bound by the whole policy.

definitions.hedging_definition: a derivative contract that hedges their exposure to movements in the price of Securities

windows.end_anchor: the day after the release of the full year results
the day after the release of the half year results

windows.start_anchor: one week before the release of a quarterly update
windows.end_anchor: the day after the release of the quarterly update

ad_hoc_blackout_authority: The Group CEO or Company Secretary notify team members of blackout periods and may notify a blackout period at other times where considered appropriate; the blackout may be lifted during a public offer. Confidentiality is not addressed. Where an unscheduled blackout overlaps a derivative exercise period, a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary considers appropriate actions.

rules.section: 1; 3; Derivatives and hedging over vested Goodman securities
rules.detail: Entering into a derivative contract is named as a Dealing and Securities include related financial products including options and derivatives with no venue limit, so an OTC put or call with a bank requires prior consent (Group CEO or Company Secretary; Chairman for Directors) valid for 10 business days and cannot be entered in a blackout period. Hedging derivatives carry the additional exercise-window condition below.
rules.evidence: Deal in Securities (including trading, entering into a margin loan or derivative contract)

rules.section: Derivatives and hedging over vested Goodman securities
rules.detail: Derivative hedges of vested Goodman Securities are expressly permitted provided the exercise window for either party does not fall in a scheduled blackout period, the arrangement complies with the law, the rest of the policy (including consent) and any other conditions such as a minimum holding requirement. If an unscheduled blackout overlaps the exercise period, the derivative must not be exercised or settled and the Company Secretary must be informed.
rules.evidence: A team member can only enter into a derivative contract that hedges their exposure to movements in the price of Securities if the exercise window for either party under that contract is not during a scheduled blackout period.

rules.section: Derivatives and hedging over vested Goodman securities
rules.detail: The policy distinguishes only vested from unvested plan securities; vested securities under a holding lock fall within the vested hedging regime but must also satisfy 'any other conditions that you may be subject to', which would include plan disposal restrictions.
rules.evidence: The arrangement must also comply with the law, the other provisions of this policy and any other conditions that you may be subject to (such as a minimum holding requirement).

rules.section: Use of derivatives and hedging over unvested Goodman securities is prohibited
rules.detail: Absolute ban on derivative contracts hedging exposure to unvested employee equity incentive plan securities, for all team members.
rules.evidence: It is contrary to this policy for team members to enter into derivative contracts that hedge their exposure to movements in the price of Securities provided under an employee equity incentive plan that have not vested.

rules.detail: Monetisation is not named. A prepaid forward or funded collar is a derivative contract (a Dealing needing consent) and, where secured on Goodman Securities, a loan subject to the margin lending rules; for key management personnel any structure characterised as a margin loan is banned.
rules.evidence: Deal in Securities (including trading, entering into a margin loan or derivative contract)

rules.detail: Outright ban on short selling, defined as selling financial products not owned or borrowed with a view to repurchasing at a lower price.
rules.evidence: Short selling of Securities by team members is prohibited.

rules.detail: Securities lending is not named; borrowing appears only within the definition of short selling.

rules.section: What are Goodman Securities?; 3; No short selling of Securities
rules.detail: CFDs are not named but are derivatives and so Securities; entering one is a Dealing requiring consent, a short CFD would offend the short selling ban and frequent CFD trading the short-term discouragement.
rules.evidence: 'Goodman Securities' or 'Securities' includes the Goodman Group stapled securities and related financial products (including options and derivatives).

rules.detail: Entering a margin loan is a Dealing requiring consent. A margin call must not be met by selling Goodman Securities when trading is not allowed, the borrower must have other resources to meet calls, and a lender's sale during a prohibited time is a breach to be disclosed immediately to the Company Secretary for Board consideration.
rules.evidence: If a team member enters into a loan to acquire securities that is secured by Goodman Securities, a margin call under that loan must not be met by the sale of Goodman Securities at a time when you would not be able to trade under this policy.

rules.detail: KMP named in the most recent Remuneration Report (which includes directors) must not have any margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities; 'margin loan' is not defined and no approval route exists.
rules.evidence: Key management personnel (as defined in the Corporations Act and included in the most recent Remuneration Report) must not have a margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities.

rules.detail: Granting a charge, lien or security interest is not named as a Dealing; the policy addresses security over Goodman Securities only in the context of margin loans.

Secured financing generally is not named; the margin lending section regulates a 'loan to acquire securities that is secured by Goodman Securities', and entering a margin loan is a Dealing needing consent. Other loans secured on Goodman Securities are not expressly addressed but would sensibly be treated the same way, with the forced-sale-in-blackout breach rule applying.
rules.evidence: If your margin lender sells any of your Securities at a time when trading is not allowed, it will be considered a breach of this policy.

rules.detail: Only 'margin loan' is banned for KMP. Because the term is undefined and the policy elsewhere describes a margin loan as a loan secured by Goodman Securities, a bank loan secured on collared securities is likely to be characterised as a margin loan and so prohibited for KMP.
rules.evidence: Key management personnel (as defined in the Corporations Act and included in the most recent Remuneration Report) must not have a margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities.

rules.detail: Short-term trading is discouraged rather than banned: team members are 'encouraged to not' frequently acquire with the intention of selling within three months. Any sale still requires consent. Sales following vesting under employee equity incentive plans are expressly not short-term trading.
rules.evidence: team members are encouraged to not frequently acquire Securities with the intention of selling them shortly after, i.e. within three months.

clearance.evidence: At all times, before trading any Securities you must inform the Group CEO or Company Secretary of your intention to trade and seek their consent. ... Consent lasts 10 business days after which time you must again seek consent to trade.

clearance.approver: Chairman (Audit Committee Chair for the Chairman)
clearance.evidence: Directors must seek the consent of the Chairman and the Chairman must seek the consent of the Audit Committee Chair.

clearance.approver: Group CEO or Company Secretary for ordinary consent; a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary for blackout-period exceptional circumstances consent
clearance.evidence: Executives (Group CEO-1) must seek the consent of a Committee comprised of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary.

carve_outs: sale of Securities following vesting under employee equity incentive plans
the rule is expressed as encouragement, not prohibition
short_term.evidence: team members are encouraged to not frequently acquire Securities with the intention of selling them shortly after, i.e. within three months.

exceptions.evidence: Consent is not required to participate in a public offer by the Group (including Rights Issues, Dividend Reinvestment Plans and Security Purchase Plans)
or where otherwise approved by the Board.

Consent is also not required where trading in Securities results in no change to the beneficial interest in the Securities (including transfer of Securities held by you into your self managed pension fund or other saving scheme in which you are a beneficiary).

exceptions.approver: Group CEO or Company Secretary if satisfied of exceptional circumstances; Committee of Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary for Executives (Group CEO-1)
exceptions.evidence: Exceptional circumstances include where a team member may need to trade Securities in accordance with a court order or court enforceable undertaking

exceptions.approver: Group CEO or Company Secretary if satisfied of exceptional circumstances; Committee of Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary for Executives (Group CEO-1)
exceptions.evidence: or on account of hardship where the team member has no other means of meeting an urgent financial commitment (this would not typically include an expected tax liability)

exceptions.approver: Group CEO or Company Secretary; Committee for Executives (Group CEO-1)
exceptions.evidence: Not all exceptional circumstances can be specified in advance and other circumstances may be deemed to be exceptional in the exercise of this policy.
The blackout period may be lifted during the making of a public offer as the market is required to be fully informed at such times.

financing.price_trigger_guidance: A margin call must not be met by selling Goodman Securities when trading is not allowed; the team member must have sufficient resources to meet a margin call by other means. No price-trigger or LVR guidance.
financing_disclosure: team members: any dealing in breach of the policy, including a margin lender's sale when trading is not allowed, must be disclosed immediately to the Company Secretary for reporting to and consideration by the Board.

team members: where an unscheduled blackout overlaps a derivative exercise period, inform the Company Secretary; a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary considers appropriate actions.
financing.minimum_shareholding_requirement: Derivative hedges must comply with 'any other conditions that you may be subject to (such as a minimum holding requirement)'; the policy does not say whether hedged securities count towards it.

external_documents: Goodman (NZ) Limited Financial Products Trading Policy and Guidelines (consent to deal in GMT Securities)
Minimum holding requirement applying to relevant team members
Most recent Remuneration Report (identifies key management personnel)
exemption_authority: The Group CEO or Company Secretary may consent to trading in a blackout period if satisfied of exceptional circumstances (court order or enforceable undertaking, hardship with no other means of meeting an urgent financial commitment, or other circumstances deemed exceptional); Executives (Group CEO-1) need a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary. The Board may approve other dealings not requiring consent. The blackout may be lifted during a public offer. A Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary decides actions where an unscheduled blackout overlaps a derivative exercise period. No authority is stated to waive the KMP margin loan ban, the unvested hedging ban or the short selling ban.
jurisdiction_overlays: NZX: dealing in GMT Securities requires consent under the Goodman (NZ) Limited Financial Products Trading Policy and Guidelines, in consultation with the Group Company Secretary
Insider trading laws of any other country where the financial products are quoted (Goodman Logistics (HK) Limited is a Hong Kong company)

bespoke_clauses.clause: A team member can only enter into a derivative contract that hedges their exposure to movements in the price of Securities if the exercise window for either party under that contract is not during a scheduled blackout period.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collar's expiry, exercise and settlement dates for both the executive and the bank must be scheduled outside the 30 June, 31 December and quarterly-update blackouts, which rules out American-style or early-termination rights exercisable in those windows.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Where an unscheduled blackout period overlaps with an exercise period, a team member must not seek to exercise or settle the derivative and should inform the Company Secretary. A Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and the Company Secretary will consider appropriate actions.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: The collar documentation needs a mechanism to defer exercise or settlement if an ad hoc blackout is declared, since the executive cannot settle and the outcome depends on a Committee decision.

bespoke_clauses.clause: You are required to have sufficient resources to meet a margin call by means other than by a sale of your Goodman Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Any loan secured on the collared shares must be structured so that top-ups can be met in cash, since selling the shares to meet a call when trading is not allowed is a breach.

bespoke_clauses.clause: If your margin lender sells any of your Securities at a time when trading is not allowed, it will be considered a breach of this policy. Any dealing in breach of this policy should immediately be disclosed to the Company Secretary for reporting to and consideration by the Board for possible disciplinary action.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Bank enforcement rights over the collateral must be contractually suspended during blackouts and while the executive holds inside information, or the executive is exposed to disciplinary action.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Key management personnel (as defined in the Corporations Act and included in the most recent Remuneration Report) must not have a margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: 'Margin loan' is undefined; a bank loan secured on collared securities with a top-up mechanism is likely to be treated as one, so the funded leg is unavailable to directors and Remuneration Report KMP even though the derivative legs are permitted with consent.

bespoke_clauses.clause: You must not trade the Securities until consent has been granted. Consent lasts 10 business days after which time you must again seek consent to trade. Consent may be withdrawn at any time before you trade in Securities if new relevant information becomes available or there is a change in circumstances.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Entry into the collar and the loan must complete within 10 business days of consent, and consent can be withdrawn before signing.

bespoke_clauses.clause: The arrangement must also comply with the law, the other provisions of this policy and any other conditions that you may be subject to (such as a minimum holding requirement).
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Shares subject to a minimum holding requirement may not be available to collar or deliver, and the bank should confirm whether hedged securities count towards that requirement.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Special risks may arise where you do not have control of securities that may be acquired or sold in respect of which you have a beneficial interest. Care should be taken in relation to giving discretionary mandates where you have a direct or indirect interest in the securities, margin loans and derivatives
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Bank discretion to sell, rehypothecate or deliver collateral is flagged as a policy risk the executive bears.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Their associates which include close family members and people or entities (such as family companies or self managed pension funds) where there is any influence over the investment process or where they are acting on behalf of the Director or employee.
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Routing the collar or loan through a family company or SMSF does not avoid consent, blackouts or the KMP margin loan ban.

bespoke_clauses.clause: Consent is also not required where trading in Securities results in no change to the beneficial interest in the Securities
bespoke_clauses.why_it_matters: Moving shares to the bank's custodian or nominee without change of beneficial interest needs no consent, though such 'trading' is not expressly excluded from blackout periods.

summary: For Goodman team members who are not key management personnel, a funded collar is possible: the policy expressly permits derivative contracts hedging vested Goodman Securities with prior consent from the Group CEO or Company Secretary (Chairman for Directors, Audit Committee Chair for the Chairman) valid for 10 business days, provided the exercise window for either party falls outside the scheduled 30 June, 31 December and quarterly-update blackouts, the arrangement respects any minimum holding requirement, and the collared securities are not unvested plan securities. A loan secured on Goodman Securities is permitted for such persons as a consented Dealing, but the executive must be able to meet margin calls from other resources, must not sell during a blackout to meet a call, and a lender's sale while trading is prohibited is a breach reportable to the Board. For directors and other KMP named in the Remuneration Report, the ban on having a margin loan in respect of Goodman Securities, with 'margin loan' undefined, makes the funded leg unavailable in practice, leaving only an unfunded collar with consent. Exercise or settlement during an unscheduled blackout is barred and referred to a Committee of the Chairman, Group CEO and Company Secretary.
